gameText: Deploys -1 to Naboo. May add 1 pilot. While Rya piloting, immune to attrition < 4. While at Naboo system, adds 1 to each of your Force drains there.

title: Bravo 5
lore: Ellberger's starfighter at the battle of Naboo has excellent evasion capabilities, and can remain a threat to its target for as long as possible.
gameText: Deploys -1 to Naboo. May add 1 pilot. While Ellberger piloting, immune to attrition < 3. While at Naboo, opponent's battleships present are power -1.

title: Bravo Fighter
lore: Flown by an unknown pilot who likes to spin a lot. Played the deciding role in the attack against the Droid Control Ship.
gameText: Permanent pilot provides ability of 3. During your control phase, if landed aboard Blockade Flagship, may draw one destiny. If destiny > 6, place Bravo Fighter in your Used Pile; Flagship 'blown away.'

title: Fambaa
lore: Pack animal domesticated by Gungan warriors. Able to bear heavy loads, even during the heat of combat.
gameText: May add 2 'riders' (passengers). Ability = 1/2. Requires +1 Force to use landspeed. May not be attacked by creatures.

title: Boss Nass
lore: Ankura Gungan who is the leader of his people. Prone to nervous tics. Personally responsible for uniting the Ankura and Otolla races together.
gameText: While at an underwater site and all of your characters on Naboo are Gungans: add one battle destiny in battles at Naboo sites and once during your deploy phase may deploy a Gungan or Steady, Steady from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Gian Speeder
lore: Military repulsorlift armed with three light repeating blasters. With a top speed of 160 kilometers per hour, they have the ability to out-flank an opponent in battle.
gameText: May add 1 driver and 3 passengers. May move as a 'react' to Naboo sites. Your battle destiny draws are +1 for each of your Royal Naboo Security present. (Limit +3.)

title: Kaadu
lore: Used by many Gungan warriors due to their fearless nature. Kaadu lay large numbers of eggs to compensate for those eaten by predators.
gameText: May add 1 'rider' (passenger). Ability = 1/2. Moves for free. While 'ridden' by a Gungan, may move as a 'react.' While at a swamp, adds 1 to your Force drains there.

title: Amidala's Blaster
lore: Amidala's ability as a warrior is underestimated by those who encounter her. With her weapon of choice, she often uses this fact to her advantage.
gameText: Deploy on Amidala. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Character is power and forfeit = 0 if destiny > defense value. Creature lost if destiny +2 > defense value.

title: Booma
lore: Launched from fambaa-mounted catapults. Gungan 'energy balls' are used to disable a variety of mechanized threats. Effectiveness is enhanced by the skill of the user.
gameText: Deploy on your Fambaa. Twice per battle may draw destiny. If destiny < total number of opponent's characters and vehicles present, one of them is lost (opponent's choice).

title: Captain Tarpals' Electropole
lore: Tarpals' electropole is nearly as old as he is. Used to enforce the laws of Otoh Gunga.
gameText: Deploys on Captain Tarpals. May 'throw' (place in Used Pile) to target a character, creature or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. If destiny +3 > defense value, target is landspeed = 0 and power -3 for remainder of turn.

title: Electropole
lore: Gungan weapon that is very similar to the Force pike. Used to control crowds, wild animals, and the occasional battle droid.
gameText: Deploy on your Gungan. May target a character for free. Draw destiny. If destiny > defense value, character is power -4 for remainder of turn. At the end of battle here, may place this electropole on top of Reserve Deck.

title: Proton Torpedoes
lore: Mainstay weapon of Naboo Defense Fighters. Anakin Skywalker used them to surprising effect, as soon as he found the trigger.
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on your N-1 starfighter. May target a starship using 1 Force. Draw Destiny. Target hit if destiny > defense value. While on Bravo Fighter and you are attempting to 'blow away' Blockade Flagship, adds 2 to your total.

title: Captain Tarpals
lore: Gungan leader of the forces that patrol and protect the city of Otoh Gunga. Consistently placed in the top ten of the Big Nasty Free-For-All.
gameText: Adds 1 to power of your other Gungans at same site. Opponent's characters may not move to underwater sites. Once per turn, if you just drew a Gungan for battle destiny, may deploy that Gungan for free to cancel that destiny and re-draw.

title: Corporal Rushing
lore: Royal Naboo security officer in charge of protecting Amidala's Throne Room. His wife and children were captured when the Trade Federation invaded the planet.
gameText: Deploys -1 to Naboo. While firing a blaster, adds one to total weapon destiny. Once per battle, if a battle droid was just hit by a blaster here, battle droid is lost and opponent loses 1 Force.

title: Dams Denna
lore: Knowledgable animal trainer and herd-master. Collector of Linn'con memorabilia.
gameText: Once during your deploy phase, you may deploy a Kaadu, Fambaa or Eopie to same site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If you just lost a creature vehicle from same site, you may place that creature in your Used Pile.

title: 2-1B
lore: Member of the droid pool on the rebel base of Hoth. Worked on Luke Skywalker and other members of Rogue Squadron who needed medical treatment.

title: Owen
lore: Only Owen Lars knew what kind of impact Anakin’s past would have on Luke. That’s what he was afraid of.

title: Lost In The Wilderness & Yub Yub!
gameText: USED: Add 1 to forfeit of each of your Ewoks for remainder of turn. LOST: Cancel a Force drain at an exterior planet site where opponent has no vehicles or starships. Draw destiny. If destiny > number of opponent's characters at that site, choose one of those characters to be missing.

title: Luke! We're Going To Have Company

titleComponents.name: Luke! We're Going To Have Company

lore: "Who is this? What's your operating number?"

title: Might Of The Republic
gameText: Once per game, retrieve 1 Force for each of your senators at Galactic Senate. (Immune to Sense.) OR Take one senator (or Coruscant Guard, Sei Taria or Mas Amedda) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Mindful Of The Future & Inconsequential Barriers
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy a unique (•) battleground not on table, from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel Imperial Barrier, None Shall Pass, or Set For Stun. OR Peek at the top card of your Force Pile; either return it, or place it under your Force Pile or Reserve Deck.

title: Mission Briefing
lore: Before the Battle of Hoth, rebel officers would fall silent the moment their commander came into the room to brief them.

title: My Loyal Bodyguard & Might Of The Republic
gameText: Once per game, retrieve 1 Force for each of your senators at Galactic Senate. (Immune to Sense.) OR Deploy a handmaiden to Amidala's location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just initiated battle at same site as your handmaiden and Amidala, add one battle destiny. OR Take one senator (or Coruscant Guard, Sei Taria or Mas Amedda) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Nabrun Leids & Quite A Mercenary
gameText: If Elis Helrot just completed a transport, use 2 Force. Elis and all characters transported are lost. (Immune to Sense.) OR At any time (except during battle), target any or all of your characters at one site to 'transport' (relocate) to any one other site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to 'transport' or place Interrupt in Lost Pile. OR Prevent a smuggler from moving this turn.

title: Narrow Escape
gameText: If opponent just initiated battle at a site where you have a Rebel of ability > 2 present, move all of your cards with ability there away (using their landspeed at normal use of Force) and cancel battle.

title: Neck And Neck
gameText: If difference between opponent's and your highest race totals < 4, lose 1 Force. Opponent draws no race destiny next control phase. OR If both players have < 10 Life Force remaining, both players retrieve 4 Force.

title: Neck And Neck & Changing The Odds
gameText: USED: If opponent just drew battle destiny (or destiny for Watto's Chance Cube), subtract one from that destiny. OR If you just verified opponent's Reserve Deck, search that Reserve Deck and place one Interrupt found there out of play. LOST: If difference between opponent's and your highest race totals < 4, lose 1 Force. Opponent draws no race destiny next control phase. OR If both players have < 10 Life Force remaining, both players retrieve 4 Force.

title: Palpatine, Senator To Naboo
lore: "A tragedy has occurred, which started right here with the taxation of trade routes and has now engulfed our entire planet in the oppression of the Trade Federation."

title: Nice Of You Guys To Drop By

titleComponents.name: Nice Of You Guys To Drop By

gameText: Send one of your missing characters at same site as one of your piloted or driven vehicles to your Used Pile. OR Cancel any attempt by one character to 'hide' from a battle.

title: Nice Of You Guys To Drop By & Visored Vision

titleComponents.name: Nice Of You Guys To Drop By

gameText: USED: Send one of your missing characters at same site as one of your piloted or driven vehicles to your Used Pile. OR Cancel any attempt by one character to 'hide' from a battle. OR Name an Interrupt card. Opponent must reveal entire Used Pile, without shuffling, Then you choose: USED: Opponent must lose 1 Force for each copy of that Interrupt found there. LOST: Each copy of that Interrupt found there is lost.

title: No Giben Up, General Jar Jar!

titleComponents.name: No Giben Up, General Jar Jar!

gameText: If you just lost a Gungan from table, place him in your hand. OR If Jar Jar and Tarpals are in a battle together, add two battle destiny.

title: No Giben Up, General Jar Jar & Gimme A Lift!

titleComponents.name: No Giben Up, General Jar Jar!

gameText: If you just lost a Gungan from table, place him in your hand. OR If Jar Jar and Tarpals are in a battle together, add two battle destiny. OR Relocate Jar Jar to a battle just initiated at an adjacent site. OR Increase Jar Jar's landspeed by 1 for remainder of turn. OR If Jar Jar on Brisky Morning Munchen, take him to hand.

title: Off The Edge
gameText: Target one of your characters at a Cloud City site. Draw destiny. If destiny > character's destiny number, retrieve Force equal to the difference. If destiny < character's destiny number, lose difference. If destiny = character's destiny number, character is lost.

title: Old Ben & Noble Sacrifice
gameText: Use 1 Force if any of your characters (except Obi-Wan) was just forfeited from a Tatooine site. Mysterious "crazy wizard" steps in and revives (relocates) that character back to same site. OR If opponent just deployed a character, sacrifice (place out of play) from table one of your characters with the same power (even a captured character). Retrieve Force equal to your sacrificed character's forfeit value.

title: Old Smoothies
lore: Lando did his best to appear delighted that his old buddy had come back to see him.

title: On The Edge & Surprise Assault
gameText: Use 1 Force and target a Rebel of ability > 2. Choose a number from 1 to 6. You may retrieve that amount of Force if you now draw destiny > chosen number. If you fail, Rebel is lost. OR Use 1 Force to cancel an opponent's Force drain at a location. Draw one destiny for each character, starship, and vehicle the opponent has present (limit 2). Compare your destiny total to opponent's power total. Player with lowest total loses Force equal to the difference.

title: Ouch Time
lore: Captain Tarpals had a way of describing certain situations to perfection.

title: Out Of Commission
gameText: During your control phase, use 2 Force to release a starship held by any Tractor Beam. (Not effective on Death Star Tractor Beam if Central Core in play.) OR Randomly select one card from opponent's Lost Pile or Blaster Rack and place out of play.

title: Rakes Jevorik
lore: Mercenary who turned against Jabba when Luke Skywalker and his friends destroyed his sail barge at the great pit of carkoon. Now seeking a new employer.

title: Perimeter Scan & Under Attack
gameText: Use 1 Force to glance at any one card which is face-down at a location. OR Use 1 Force to glance at opponent's hand. You may place each droid spy and Infantry Mine you find there in opponent's Used Pile. OR During your control phase, target a vehicle with armor present with your warrior. Draw destiny. If warrior has a Concussion Grenade or a lightsaber add 3 to destiny draw (7 if both). Vehicle (and grenade) lost if total destiny > armor.

title: Podrace Prep & Too Close For Comfort
gameText: LOST: Cancel Hit Racer or Podracer Collision. STARTING: Deploy Podrace Arena (with a Podracer, opponent may also deploy a Podracer there), Boonta Eve Podrace, and any Effect that deploys for free. Place Interrupt in Reserve Deck.

title: Quite A Mercenary
gameText: If Elis Helrot just completed a transport, use 2 Force. Elis and all characters transported are lost. (Immune to Sense.) OR Prevent a just-deployed smuggler from moving this turn.

title: Rebel Leadership
gameText: Your admirals and generals are forfeit +1 for remainder of turn. OR If your admiral is in a battle at a system (or your general, except Obi-Wan, is in a battle at a site), either add one battle destiny or prevent opponent from drawing more than one battle destiny.

title: Rebel Leadership & Throw Me Another Charge
gameText: If your admiral is in battle at a system (or your general, except Obi-Wan, is in battle at a site), you may either add one battle destiny or prevent opponent from drawing more than one battle destiny. OR Take one automated weapon into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Add 1 to Deactivate The Shield Generator total. OR Cancel Trooper Charge, Blasted Droid, Trooper Assault, or Dark Jedi Presence.

title: Recoil In Fear
gameText: Use 3 Force. Each player counts cards in hand, then places entire hand and Used Pile onto Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Each player then draws from Reserve Deck the counted number of cards to create a new hand.

title: Return Of A Jedi & Luke's Back
gameText: Use 1 Force to retrieve Obi-Wan or Luke from Lost Pile. OR Use 3 Force to take Obi-Wan or Luke into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Sabotage & Slight Weapons Malfunction
gameText: During your control phase, target one weapon, device, or vehicle at same site as your Undercover spy. Draw destiny. If destiny > target's deploy cost, target is lost (may be stolen instead if spy also a thief). OR Cancel Informant. OR If your weapon (except a lightsaber) was just fired during a battle, add one battle destiny.

title: See You At The Rendezvous
lore: Most rebels had their minds set on regrouping with the fleet as soon as possible. Luke had other plans.

title: Skull & Mandalorian Mishap
gameText: During a battle or attack, place out of play one non-droid character, creature, or creature vehicle from your Lost Pile. Add its destiny number to your total power. OR Take Fallen Portal into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If Boba Fett is defending a battle, draw one battle destiny. Subtract that amount from opponent's attrition and total power.

title: Senator Organa
lore: "Aren’t you a little short for a Stormtrooper?"

title: Smoke Screen
gameText: During a battle at a site, if you are about to draw a card for battle destiny, you may instead use the ability number of one of your characters involved in the battle.

title: Smoke Screen & It's A Trap!
gameText: Use 3 force to cancel any battle just initiated at a site. (Immune to Sense.) OR During a battle at a site, if you are about to draw a card for battle destiny, you may instead use the ability number of one of your characters involved in the battle.

title: Sorry About The Mess
gameText: During your control phase, fire one of your weapons. If Han firing, may add 1 to each weapon destiny draw. (A seeker may be targeted by a character weapon using defense value 4.) Any 'hit' targets are immediately lost.

title: Speak With The Jedi Council & Vote Now!
gameText: USED: If the Jedi Council Chamber is not on table, you may deploy it from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During your control phase, draw destiny. If destiny > 2, draw up to X cards (maximum 4) from Reserve Deck, where X = your total politics at Galactic Senate minus opponent's total politics at Galactic Senate. LOST: Deploy one Jedi Council member to the Jedi Council Chamber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Stay Here
lore: "But I..."

title: Strangle
gameText: Target an escort alone and its captive. Draw destiny. Escort lost if destiny + captive's power > escort's ability + power. OR During a battle at a site where Leia is an escorted captive, add one battle destiny.

title: Strike Blocked
gameText: Take top card of Force Pile into hand. OR If opponent just revealed a combat card, it is canceled (place in opponent's Used Pile) and opponent must draw destiny instead (that destiny is reduced by 1). OR Cancel Maul Strikes, Dark Strike, or You Are Beaten.

title: Taking On The Whole Empire By Myself

titleComponents.name: Taking On The Whole Empire By Myself

lore: Rogue Squadron took pride in its dedication to serve the alliance, even if it meant never returning home from the battlefield.

title: The Force Is Strong With This One & Jedi Presence

titleComponents.name: The Force Is Strong With This One

gameText: If Luke and an Imperial with ability > 2 are involved in the same battle, add one battle destiny (add 2 if Imperial is Vader). OR if one of your Jedi is present during any battle, use 1 Force to cause all other Rebels there to battle at double power.

title: The Signal & Jedi Mind Trick
gameText: USED: Use 3 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one Effect of any kind into hand; reshuffle. OR Cancel a Force drain at a site if Luke is at an adjacent site. LOST: If your character of ability > 4 is present with an opponent's leader, release a captive from a related prison (canceled if opponent loses 2 Force).

title: Solo
lore: "I’m captain of the Millennium Falcon. Chewie tells me you’re looking for passage to the Alderaan system."

title: This Is More Like It & I Have A Really Bad Feeling About This

titleComponents.name: I Have A Really Bad Feeling About This

gameText: USED: During a battle, lose X Force to reduce attrition against you by X. LOST: Use 3 Force to relocate any Effect (except those immune to Alter) deployed on a location to another appropriate location.

title: Too Close For Comfort
gameText: USED: If your character was just targeted by a weapon, opponent must use 2 Force or the targeting is canceled. LOST: Cancel Hit Racer or Podracer Collision.

title: Under Attack
gameText: During your control phase, target a vehicle with armor at same site as one of your warriors. Draw destiny. If warrior has a Concussion Grenade or a lightsaber, add 3 to destiny draw (7 if both). Vehicle (and grenade) lost if total destiny > armor.

title: Vote Now!
gameText: During your control phase, draw destiny. If destiny > 2, draw up to X cards (maximum 4) from Reserve Deck, where X = your total politics at Galactic Senate minus opponent's total politics at Galactic Senate.

title: Walker Sighting
gameText: If opponent just moved or deployed an AT-AT to a planet site, deploy up to three related exterior sites from your Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: We Can Still Outmaneuver Them
gameText: USED: Take Collision! or Egregious Pilot Error into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: If opponent just initiated a battle with at least two capital starships at a system where you have a lone starfighter, add two battle destiny.

title: We Don't Need Their Scum
gameText: USED: Cancel Res Luk Ra'auf. LOST: If two bounty hunters (or an Imperial and a bounty hunter) are in a battle together, use 2 Force to draw two destiny. Subtract total from opponent's attrition and total power (cannot fall below zero).

title: We Don't Want To Cause Any Trouble

titleComponents.name: We Don't Want To Cause Any Trouble

lore: By leaving their droids out of the action, our heroes were able to find success in one of the most wretched spaceports in the entire galaxy.

title: We Wish To Board At Once

titleComponents.name: We Wish To Board At Once

gameText: Use 3 Force to take one Effect of any kind into hand from your Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Take Radiant VII, or one Interrupt with the word 'Podracer(s)' in its game text, into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: We Wish To Board At Once & Are You Brain Dead?!

titleComponents.name: We Wish To Board At Once

gameText: USED: Take Radiant VII, or one Interrupt with the word "Podracer(s)" in its game text, into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Use 3 Force to take one Effect of any kind into hand from your Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Target your Episode I Jedi defending a battle. Target is immune to attrition for rest of turn (unless a Dark Jedi present). LOST: In a battle you lost, place a Jedi Council Member you just forfeited into Used Pile to cancel all battle damage and attrition against you.

title: Tiinn
lore: Jawa accountant involved with tracking Coilen in and around the Dune Sea. Transmits Coilen’s activities to Tatooine officials every day; he’s still waiting to hear back from them.

title: Were You Looking For Me? & I Know
gameText: USED: Take one or two communications or protocol droids (or one of each) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: Retrieve C-3PO. OR If C-3PO is in battle at a site, add one battle destiny (or two if with three Ewoks). OR If Leia and Han are in a battle together, add two battle destiny. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against Han, you may 'react' by deploying there (for free) Leia and/or her matching weapon from hand and/or Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Wookiee Strangle & We'll Find Han
gameText: Use 2 Force to target an opponent's non-droid character present with one of your Wookiees. Both players draw destiny. Add ability and power. Target is lost if Wookiee's total destiny > target's total destiny. OR If Chewie and your Lando are in a battle together, subtract 3 from attrition against you (cannot fall below zero). OR Cancel I Had No Choice.

title: Yoda I Must Know
lore: Fearing Ben Kenobi had lied to him, Luke needed to hear the truth from Yoda himself.

title: You Will Take Me To Jabba Now

titleComponents.name: You Will Take Me To Jabba Now

gameText: If Jabba is at a Jabba's Palace site, relocate one of your characters to that location from a related site. OR During your deploy phase, deploy one alien (at normal use of the Force) from Reserve Deck to the Audience Chamber; reshuffle.

title: You Will Take Me To Jabba Now & Strangle

titleComponents.name: You Will Take Me To Jabba Now

gameText: USED: If Jabba is at a Jabba's Palace site, relocate one of your characters to that location from a related site. OR During your deploy phase, deploy one alien from Reserve Deck to Audience Chamber; reshuffle. LOST: Target an escort alone and its captive. Draw destiny. Escort lost if destiny + captive's power > escort's ability + power. OR During a battle at a site where Leia is an escorted captive, add one battle destiny.

title: Yousa Guys Bombad!
lore: Jedi tend to slice through battle droids like butter.

title: Wedge
lore: Rogue Squadron leader who assisted Gold Squadron One during its historic attack run on the second Death Star.

title: Yoda, Jedi Master
lore: "No! No, no! Stay and help you I will."

title: Young Skywalker
lore: "Luke’s just not a farmer, Owen. He has too much of his father in him."

title: Gungan Celebration Trumpet
lore: Instrument used by the Gungans at celebratory occasions. Its sound was never heard in Theed until the aftermath of the Battle of Naboo.

title: Anakin Skywalker
lore: Vader. "He can help you." "You refer to the prophecy of the one who will bring balance to the Force." "The boy is dangerous. They all sense it. Why can’t you?"

title: A Gift
gameText: If you just moved a droid to Audience Chamber, deploy on that droid. Droid is an undercover spy. Wherever opponent has an alien, opponent's battle destiny draws are -2 and Force drains are -1. Effect lost if droid leaves Tatooine. (Immune to Control.)

title: Ackbar's Assault Plan
lore: Admiral Ackbar and General Madine's plan to eliminate the Empire had its fair share of setbacks.

title: Aim High
gameText: Deploy on table. When you fire two weapons (except lightsabers) in a battle, your total power is +5. Also, whenever opponent retrieves X cards, opponent must first use X Force or that retrieval is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Bad Lifters And Faulty Wings
lore: "No, no! No! This one goes there, that one goes there, right?"

title: Beggar & Revolution
gameText: Use 3 Force to deploy on a location. Rotate the location so that the icons and game texts switch direction. (If Expand the Empire present, it also switches.) If Effect later canceled, location rotates back again. Also, you may use any amount of Force in the opponent's Force Pile during your turns. However, if you use more than 1 of the opponent's Force in a turn, Effect is lost at the end of that turn.

title: Bring Me The Hydrospanners!
lore: When nothing works, just start hitting things and something's bound to happen.

title: Brisky Morning Munchen
gameText: Deploy on table. Once per game, may deploy Jar Jar from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If you just lost Jar Jar from a site, may place him here. At any time, may use 3 Force to take Jar Jar from here into hand.

title: Close Air Support
gameText: Deploy on table. While your Z-95 occupies a system or cloud sector, once per turn your scout at a related exterior site may add one battle destiny (if Z-95 is Tala 1 or Tala 2, may also add one destiny to total power only).

title: Close Air Support & Commando Training
gameText: Deploy on table. While your Z-95 occupies a system or cloud sector, once per turn your scout at a related exterior site may add one battle destiny (if Z-95 is Tala 1 or Tala 2, may also add one destiny to total power only). Also, each of your non-unique Rebels armed with a non-unique blaster is forfeit +2, adds 1 to his total weapon destiny and, where present, cumulatively adds 1 to total battle destiny. (Immune to Alter while your non-unique blaster is on table.)

title: Congratulations
lore: Rebel officers hadn't celebrated in years when they destroyed the second Death Star. Finally, their moment of triumph had arrived.

title: Chewbacca
lore: Smuggler. Was attempting to repair the Millennium Falcon before the Empire located the rebel base on the planet Hoth. Known to enjoy the rug hug.

title: Crack Shot & Quick Draw
gameText: Deploy on table. Any card which is 'hit' may not be used to satisfy attrition. Also, once during your draw phase, you may use 2 Force to deploy a blaster from your Lost Pile (for free). (Immune to Alter.)

title: Crash Site Memorial
gameText: Deploy on table. You may place lost vehicles, droids, weapons and devices here instead of Lost Pile. Once each turn, during your deploy phase, you may exchange any one hand card with one card from your 'memorial'.

title: Credits Will Do Fine & We're Leaving
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy on table. If you just initiated a Force drain (or won a battle) at Watto's Junkyard, opponent loses 1 Force (cannot be reduced) and stacks lost card here face down. Also, if you just forfeited all your cards that participated in a battle that opponent initiated, you may place this Effect out of play to cancel all remaining battle damage; place all cards here in owner's Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Gungan Energy Shield
gameText: Deploy on an exterior site. While your Fambaa here: your characters here may not be targeted by weapons, opponent's battle destiny draws here are -1, and characters must use +1 Force when moving to or from here using their landspeed.

title: Hiding In The Garbage
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy on table. At any time, you may declare a card type. Use Force one by one, revealing each card used, until a card of that type is revealed (take it into hand) or Force Pile is depleted.

title: I Hope She's All Right
gameText: Deploy on table. During every draw phase, unless opponent's character of destiny < 4 occupies a battleground site, opponent loses 1 Force. Effect canceled unless your characters of destiny < 4 occupy two battleground sites.

title: I Must Be Allowed To Speak

titleComponents.name: I Must Be Allowed To Speak

gameText: Deploy on a Jabba's Palace site. Luke may deploy at this site regardless of presence or location deployment restrictions. When he is deployed here, relocate Effect to Luke, he is immune to attrition while on Tatooine. (Immune to Alter.)

title: I Must Be Allowed To Speak & Goo Nee Tay

titleComponents.name: I Must Be Allowed To Speak

gameText: Deploy on a Jabba's Palace site. Luke may deploy at this site regardless of presence or location deployment restrictions. When he is deployed here, relocate Effect to Luke, he is immune to attrition while on Tatooine and all opponent's characters of ability > 2 are deploy +2 here. (Immune to Alter.)

title: I Thought He Was Blind
lore: He apparently can see much better now.

title: I Will Not Defer & Plea To The Court
gameText: Deploy on table. If no senator here, you may place a senator here from hand to cancel an opponent's Force drain or to add 2 to your next Force drain at a battleground this turn. If a peace agenda here, once per turn you may activate up to 2 Force when opponent initiates battle. If a justice agenda here, during a battle where opponent has a weapon and you do not, may cancel a just drawn weapon destiny to cause a re-draw.

title: Commander Myron Konkle
lore: Electronics expert who assisted in the analysis of the Death Star data supplied by R2-D2. Former Imperial engineer who defected from the Star Destroyer Avenger.

title: Inspecting The Garbage
lore: Chewbacca made some new friends when he found C-3PO in the Cloud City incinerator.

title: Is Your Strike Team Assembled?
lore: "My team's assembled but I don't have a command crew for the shuttle."

title: Lapti Nek
lore: "Rat a ran wim joct co jappi qaff."

title: Launching The Assault
gameText: Deploy on a system. Once per game, you may take Home One into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Force drains are +1 at battleground systems where you have a Star Cruiser piloted by a character. Effect canceled if Rendezvous Point on table. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Looking To The Future
lore: With Cloud City and Hoth behind them it was time for the Rebel Alliance to regroup and rebuild.

title: Obi-Wan's Cape & Lightsaber Proficiency
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on a character with ability > 2 armed with a lightsaber. That character is power +3 in battles, immune to attrition < 5, and may add 1 to Force drain where present. Also, when present at the start of a battle, may use 1 Force to cause one opponent's character of ability = 1 (your choice) to move away (for free), or that character is immediately lost. Effect lost if character loses lightsaber.

title: Prisoner Transfer
lore: Using Stormtrooper uniforms to disguise yourself in an Imperial battlestation - good plan.

title: Projection Of A Skywalker & Yarna d'al' Gargan
gameText: Deploy on any planet site. Opponent's Force drains are -1 here. Also, while you have fewer than 13 cards in hand, your non-unique cards in hand (except Effects of any kind and Interrupts) are immune to Monnok. (Immune to Alter while you occupy 2 battlegrounds.)

title: Revolution
gameText: Use 3 Force to deploy on any location. Rotate the location so that icons and game texts switch direction. (If Expand the Empire present, it also switches.) If Revolution later canceled, location rotates back again.

title: Scramble
gameText: Deploy on opponent's side of table. Opponent's pilots (except Vader) present at sites may not use ability to draw battle destiny. Effect canceled when opponent has no pilots at sites.

title: Drem Redins
lore: Ishi Tib gambler responsible for handling and paying out on small wagers at Boonta Eve. Rumored to be losing money because of his odds not being as desirable as Jabba’s.

title: Scramble & Hiding In The Garbage
gameText: Deploy on table. At any time, you may declare a card type. Use Force one by one, revealing each card used, until a card of that type is revealed (take it into hand) or Force Pile is depleted. Also, opponent's pilots (except Vader) present at sites may not use ability to draw battle destiny. Effect canceled when opponent has no pilots at sites.

title: That's The Real Trick
lore: "Let's just say we'd like to avoid any Imperial entanglements."

title: They All Broken
lore: The weakness of battle droids is in that they must rely on a central command source. Gungans on the other hand rely on leaders such as Jar Jar Binks to guide them.

title: This Is Your Father's Lightsaber
lore: "Not as clumsy or random as a blaster."

title: Through The Planet Core
lore: "Master what's a bongo?" The way to Theed was a bit more complicated than that of an underwater joy ride.

title: Traffic Control
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on table. During your control phase, you may return any cards from your hand to the top of your Used Pile.

title: Traffic Control & Crash Site Memorial
gameText: Deploy on table. You may place lost vehicles, droids, weapons, and devices here instead of Lost Pile. Once during your deploy phase, you may exchange any one card from hand with one card from your 'memorial.' Also, during your control phase, you may return any cards from your hand to the top of your Used Pile.

title: We Are Brave, Your Highness
lore: "Then I will plead our case to the Senate."

title: You Must Complete Your Training
lore: "You must not go!"

title: A Few Maneuvers
gameText: Add 2 to hyperspeed and maneuver of any starfighter for remainder of turn. (Interrupt may even affect the result immediately after a destiny draw targeting the starfighter's maneuver.)

title: Ewok Tribesman
lore: Tribesmen are often in charge of making critical decisions that affect an entire tribe. Allowing Han Solo and his strike team into their village was one of those decisions.

title: A Few Maneuvers & Han's Dice
gameText: Add 2 to hyperspeed and maneuver of any starfighter for the remainder of this turn. (Interrupt may even affect the result immediately after a destiny draw targeting the starfighter's maneuver.) OR If one of your characters of ability > 2 is in a battle, use 1 Force to draw another battle destiny instead of the one you just drew.

title: All Wings Report In
gameText: Once per game, target one non-unique starfighter on table. Draw destiny. If destiny < X, retrieve X Force; X = number of copies of that card you have on table. (Immune to Sense.) OR Take one non-unique starfighter into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Armed And Dangerous & Ambush
gameText: During your turn, target a site where your total power is more than double opponent's total power. Unless opponent has a Dark Jedi or character weapon there, place each opponent character, vehicle, and starship there (and cards on them) in owner's Used Pile. OR If a battle or duel was just initiated at a site, search your hand or Reserve Deck for one unique weapon matching one of your participating characters. Immediately deploy that weapon (for free) on that character and reshuffle (if from Reserve Deck).

title: Attack Pattern Delta
gameText: If a battle was just initiated at a site, identify your lead T-47 there. For remainder of this turn, all other T-47s at same site are power +1, are immune to attrition and cannot be targeted by weapons.

title: Away Put Your Weapon & Put That Down
gameText: USED: If a lightsaber was just used to enhance a Force drain, place it in Owner's Used Pile. LOST: Place any or all of your devices and character weapons on table in your Used Pile. OR If one of your characters was just targeted by a weapon during battle, use 3 Force to cancel that targeting.

title: Bickering At Its Finest
lore: "Don't try to blame me. I didn't ask you to turn on the thermal heater. I merely commented that it was freezing in the princess's chamber."

title: Biker Scout Down
lore: In places as remote as Endor forests, rebel strike forces hold no mercy towards their Imperial adversaries.

title: Blaster Deflection
gameText: USED: Cancel an attempt to use a character weapon to target your character of ability > 4. LOST: If your character of ability > 4 with a lightsaber was just targeted by a blaster, use 3 Force to re-target that blaster to an opponent's character present.

title: Careful Planning & Heading For The Medical Frigate
gameText: USED: If a battle was just initiated, draw destiny and activate up to that much Force. STARTING: If you have not deployed an Objective, deploy from Reserve Deck one battleground site related to your starting location. Also, you may deploy up to two Effects if each of them deploys for free, is always immune to Alter and has "deploy on table" (or "deploy on your side of table") in its game text. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.

title: Choke & Blaster Deflection
gameText: USED: Cancel an attempt to use a character weapon to target your character of ability > 4. LOST: If your character of ability > 4 with a lightsaber was just targeted by a blaster, use 3 Force to re-target that blaster to an opponent's character present. OR During your control phase, cancel the game text of one unique (•) alien for remainder of turn. OR If you just forfeited an alien, cancel all remaining attrition against you.

title: Goldenrod
lore: "With all we’ve been through, sometimes I’m amazed we’re in as good condition as we are, what with the Rebellion and all."

title: Clash Of Sabers
gameText: Use 2 Force to target a character present with your warrior with a lightsaber. Target cannot move or battle until end of your next turn. OR Cancel Presence Of The Force. OR Use 1 Force to take Uncontrollable Fury into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Clinging To The Very Edge
lore: Sometimes Obi-Wan’s point of view is a bit hard to understand.

title: Corellian Retort & Fly Casual
gameText: USED: During your deploy phase, deploy one starship (deploy -1) and/or one pilot to a system even without presence or Force icons. LOST: Take one Tydirium or Tantive IV into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If a bounty hunter (or gangster) and Han are involved in the same battle, you may add one battle destiny (add two if gangster is Jabba).

title: Corellian Slip
gameText: If opponent just initiated a Tallon Roll, add your maneuver + ability of one pilot on your targeted starfighter to your total. OR Decrease the maneuver of an opponent's starfighter by 1 for remainder of this turn.

title: Droid Overboard
lore: Communications droids are a low priority when the time for an attack has come.

title: Effective Repairs & Punch It!
gameText: USED: Cancel Limited Resources. LOST: Use 3 Force to search your Lost Pile and take one Effect, Utinni Effect, Mobile Effect, or Immediate Effect into hand. OR If Han or your Lando is piloting a starfighter which is defending a battle at a system, add one battle destiny (add two if starfighter is Falcon). Also, starfighter is immune to attrition for remainder of turn.

title: Either Way, You Win & Eventually You'll Lose
gameText: USED: If a battle was just initiated, place the top card of your Used Pile on top of your Reserve Deck. LOST: Use 3 Force to cause opponent to reveal hand. All cards opponent has 3 or more of in hand are lost. OR Opponent chooses: opponent may activate up to 2 Force and you may activate up to 4 Force, or opponent retrieves 1 Force and you retrieve 3 Force.

title: Entering The Arena
gameText: USED: Once per game may take Podracer Bay into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: During a battle at Podracer Bay, add one battle destiny.

title: Eventually You'll Lose
gameText: USED: If a battle was just initiated, place the top card of your Used Pile on top of your Reserve Deck. LOST: Use 3 Force to cause opponent to reveal hand. All cards opponent has 3 or more of in hand are lost.

title: False Past
lore: Luke thought his father was an ordinary pilot on a spice freighter. Dealing with his father's true identity would take him places he'd never dreamed possible.

title: Jar Jar
lore: "No, no. Mesa stay. Mesa called Jar Jar Binks. Mesa your humble servant."

title: Father, Please...
lore: With no other options left, Luke had to look to his father for assistance; assistance that would bring balance to the Force.

title: Fly Casual
gameText: USED: Cancel Early Warning Network or It's An Older Code. OR Deploy a starship (deploy -1) and/or one pilot to a system even without presence or Force icons. LOST: Take one Tydirium or Tantive IV into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Gift Of The Mentor & Skywalkers
gameText: If Luke is with Obi-Wan or Leia in a battle, add two battle destiny. (Four if with both.)

title: Glancing Blow
gameText: If you have a character with a lightsaber present in a battle with Vader, lose 1 Force to reduce Vader's power to zero. OR If you have a character with a lightsaber in a duel, cancel one opponent's destiny draw immediately after it is revealed.

title: Han's Back & Leia's Back
gameText: Use 1 Force to retrieve Han or Leia from Lost Pile. OR Use 3 Force to take Han or Leia into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi & Double Agent
gameText: If Obi-Wan is at a site you control, he may apply any amount of his ability toward drawing a battle destiny at any other location. Ability he uses this way cannot be used again this turn. OR One rebel may move as a 'react' to an adjacent battle site. OR If both players have a spy at same site, draw destiny. Add 2 if opponent's spy is Undercover. Opponent's spy is lost if destiny > 2.

title: How Did We Get Into This Mess?

titleComponents.name: How Did We Get Into This Mess?

gameText: If one of your droids is at the Dune Sea or where there is a Scomp link, use 1 Force to discard your entire hand to your Used Pile. Draw the same number of cards from your Reserve Deck. Draw one extra card if droid is C-3PO or R2-D2.

title: Hyper Escape
gameText: Cancel a battle just initiated at a system by moving all your starships there away.

title: I Have A Really Bad Feeling About This

titleComponents.name: I Have A Really Bad Feeling About This

gameText: If opponent just initiated a battle where opponent has more than double your power, target your highest-ability character in that battle. Draw destiny. If destiny < target's ability, deploy one character there from hand (for free).

title: I Used To Live Here, You Know?

titleComponents.name: I Used To Live Here, You Know?

lore: "You’re going to die here, you know?"

title: Old Ben Kenobi
lore: "Hello there! Come here my little friend, don’t be afraid."

title: Inconsequential Barriers
gameText: Cancel Imperial Barrier, None Shall Pass, or Set For Stun. OR Peek at the top card of your Force Pile; either return it, or place it under your Force Pile or Reserve Deck.

title: Insertion Planning
gameText: If your scout is in battle at an exterior planet site, subtract 3 from opponent's total battle destiny. OR Target opponent's character aboard an open vehicle moving to your scout's site. Draw destiny. If destiny +2 > ability, target goes to Used Pile.

title: Insertion Planning & Critical Error Revealed
gameText: If your scout is in battle at an exterior planet site, subtract 3 from opponent's total battle destiny. OR Target opponent's character aboard an open vehicle moving to your scout's site. Draw destiny. If destiny +2 > ability, target goes to Used Pile. OR If you have a leader at your war room, peek at top card of opponent's Reserve Deck. You may place it on bottom of that Reserve Deck.

title: Jedi Leap & Clinging To The Edge
gameText: During your deploy phase, lose 1 Force to relocate Episode I Obi-Wan to an adjacent Naboo site. OR Raise your converted interior Theed Palace site to the top. OR If opponent's Dark Jedi with at least one combat card just initiated lightsaber combat against your Jedi with none, draw 3 destiny and choose 2 to use for lightsaber combat destiny. You may take other card into hand, or return it to top of Reserve Deck.

title: Jedi Presence
gameText: If one of your Jedi is present during any battle, use 1 Force to cause all other Rebels there to battle at double power.

title: Jedi Tactics
lore: Obi-Wan and Qui-Gon knew each other's combat tactics well enough to efficiently put their dark enemy on the defensive during their fateful battle.

title: Keep Your Eyes Open & Shoo! Shoo!
gameText: Glance at the cards in any Lost Pile and replace unshuffled. OR If you have a droid on table: Cancel an attack just initiated by a creature. OR Relocate one opponent's creature (except an attached creature) to an adjacent location (habitat permitting).

title: Light Maneuvers & Jedi Levitation
gameText: USED: Cancel Dark Maneuvers, Emergency Deployment, Lone Pilot, I Want That Ship, Defensive Fire, Rogue Asteroid, or Take Evasive Action. OR Double Special Modifications until end of turn. LOST: Use X Force, where X = (7 - ability of your highest ability character on table). Search through your Used Pile and take one card into hand. Shuffle, Cut and replace.

title: Losing Track
gameText: USED: During battle, place top card of opponent's Lost Pile on top of their Reserve Deck. LOST: Use 1 Force to 'repair' your Podracer. OR Target a Podracer. Draw destiny. If destiny > Podracer's destiny number, target is 'damaged.'

title: Losing Track & A Step Backwards
gameText: USED: During battle, place top card of opponent's Lost Pile on top of their Reserve Deck. LOST: Use 1 Force to 'repair' your Podracer. OR Target a Podracer. Draw destiny. If destiny > Podracer's destiny number, target is 'damaged.' OR Place the top race destiny of all Podracers in owner's Used Pile. OR Place 3 cards from hand (random choice) into your Lost Pile to take any one character from your Lost Pile into hand.

title: 2X-3KPR (Tooex)
lore: Simple maintenance and diagnostics droid. Activates alarm sensors, security lighting and power fences on remote installations. KPR servant droids built by Lerrimore Droids.
gameText: Where present under 'nighttime conditions,' each of your Rebels and aliens at same planet site are power +2, and also have immunity to attrition < 3 if a Hydroponics Station is present.

title: General Dodonna
lore: Skilled tactician and natural leader. Planned attack on Death Star after analyzing technical readouts provided by Princess Leia. Star Destroyer captain during Old Republic.
gameText: Increases Rebel Planners by 1, doubles if at same site. May use 1 Force to cancel Wrong Turn. Each Rebel present with him at a Yavin 4 site is power +1.

title: Old Ben
lore: 'That old man's just a crazy wizard.' Obi-Wan lived in Tatooine's deserts for years...ready for the right moment to act.
gameText: Use 1 Force if any of your characters (except Obi-Wan) was just forfeited from a Tatooine site. Mysterious 'crazy wizard' steps in and revives (returns from Lost Pile) that character back to same site.

title: On The Edge
lore: Luke and Leia nearly fell over the retracted bridge across the Death Star's central core while trying to elude stormtroopers. They were soon trapped on the precipice.
gameText: Use 1 Force and target one Rebel (on table) of ability > 2. Choose a number from 1 to 6. You may retrieve that amount from your Lost Pile if you now draw destiny > chosen number. If you fail, Rebel is lost.

title: Out Of Nowhere
lore: Black market sensor-stealth arrays can be used to hide starships from enemy sensor scans. Stellar interference can naturally shield a starship for surprise attacks.
gameText: If opponent just initiated a battle at a system or sector where you have a starship with maneuver > 3, use 1 Force to add one battle destiny.

title: Panic
lore: Cornered by Imperial troops, Han's gambler reflexes led him to do what comes naturally - attack! Surprise assaults work...sometimes.
gameText: If opponent just initiated a battle where opponent has more than double your power, reveal up to 3 cards from your Reserve Deck. Of those 3, deploy anywhere (for free) any characters, starships, vehicles, devices or weapons. Any others are lost.

title: Radar Scanner
lore: Sensor on Luke's landspeeder. Many possible settings. Can scan for life forms, movement or concentrations of metal. Used for traffic control on settled worlds.
gameText: If you have at least one vehicle or starship on table, use 1 Force to glance at the cards in the opponent's hand for 10 seconds. You may move each Jawa (except Dathcha) and Tusken Raider you find there to opponent's Used Pile.

title: Rebel Barrier
lore: While being chased through the Death Star, Luke and Leia disabled the blast doors behind them in order to slow down pursuing stormtroopers.
gameText: Use 1 Force to prevent any character or starship just deployed by the opponent from battling or moving for the remainder of this turn.

title: Rebel Reinforcements
lore: Rebels rely on hidden 'cells' of undercover operatives. Striking from hidden bases, troops or starfighters can arrive in a battle zone at any time.
gameText: If opponent outnumbers you in total characters and starships on table, use 1 Force to draw destiny. That number of Rebel Troopers and/or Y-Wings, may be retrieved from Lost Pile.

title: Return Of A Jedi
lore: 'Where did you dig up that old fossil?' 'I don't think he exists anymore.' 'Surely he must be dead by now.' 'I can't believe he's gone.' 'Oh, he's not dead, not yet.' Obi's back!
gameText: If Obi-Wan is lost, use 1 Force to retrieve him from the Lost Pile. OR Use 3 Force to search through your Reserve Deck and take Obi-Wan into your hand. Shuffle deck, cut and replace.

title: Scomp Link Access
lore: A computer connection access port used mainly by droids to plug into database networks and locate information, evaluate threats, execute diagnostics or perform maintenance.
gameText: If one of your 'R' unit droids is at any Scomp link, you may: glance at the cards in any Reserve Deck for 20 seconds. Shuffle, cut and replace. OR If also at a Death Star site, cancel We're All Gonna Be A Lot Thinner or Boring Conversation Anyway.

title: Sense
lore: Users of the Force can sense impending danger by feeling the way the Force flows in others. Cataclysmic events can be sensed (as when Obi-Wan felt Alderaan's destruction).
gameText: Cancel one Interrupt (or one 'react') by drawing a destiny < ability of your highest-ability character on table. OR Cancel one Alter card just played.

title: Han Solo
lore: Smuggler, gambler and 'freelance law-bender.' Crafty Corellian pirate. Rebel hero. Owns Millennium Falcon. Co-pilot Chewbacca promised him 'life-debt.' Has bounty on head.
gameText: Once during battle, may use 1 Force to cancel and re-draw your just drawn destiny. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Falcon, also adds 2 to maneuver and may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

title: Skywalkers
lore: Luke and Leia escaped to an unused portion of the Death Star, evading security checkpoints. At a retracted bridge, they swung across on a grappling line through enemy fire.
gameText: If Luke and Leia are in a battle together, you may add two battle destiny OR Cancel Imperial Barrier or Wrong Turn or Retract The Bridge.

title: Solo Han
lore: As a smuggler, Solo must always be alert for trouble, even when appearing relaxed. Bounty hunters are eager to claim the price on the Corellian pirate's head.
gameText: If Han is defending a battle alone at a site, add two battle destiny. OR If your alien is defending a battle alone at a site, add one battle destiny.

title: Spaceport Speeders
lore: Spaceport Speeders buys, trades and sells floaters. Wioslea is known as a shrewd bargainer. Luke got 2,000 credits for his X-24 speeder.
gameText: Sell one of your vehicles or droids at Mos Eisley or same site as Wioslea. Draw two destiny (three destiny if vehicle is Luke's X-34 Landspeeder). The total is the 'offer,' which you must accept. Activate that much Force; then vehicle or droid is lost.

title: Surprise Assault
lore: Imperial troops with strict orders are often caught off-guard by innovative Rebel ambushes, sneak attacks, or sabotage efforts.
gameText: Use 1 Force to cancel a Force drain at one location. Draw one destiny for each character, starship and vehicle the opponent has present. Compare your destiny total to opponent's power total. Player with lowest total loses Force equal to the difference.

title: Thank The Maker
lore: Reference to 'One Who Creates,' used by droids in an almost religious way. C-3PO used phrase upon getting a much-needed cleansing oil bath.
gameText: Use 1 Force during opponent's control phase if you have a droid on the table and were drained of at least 5 Force. Draw destiny. That number of cards are randomly selected and retrieved from your Lost Pile.

title: The Bith Shuffle
lore: Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes play at the Cantina with a distinctive rocking motion. When Luke arrived, they were playing one of their favorite songs, 'Mad About Me.'
gameText: Shuffle any player's Reserve Deck or Lost Pile or Used Pile.

title: The Force Is Strong With This One

titleComponents.name: The Force Is Strong With This One

lore: Luke's piloting skills and Force abilities made his X-wing a difficult target for Darth Vader as they raced down the Death Star trench.
gameText: If Luke and an Imperial with ability > 2 are involved in the same battle, you may add one battle destiny (add 2 if Imperial is Vader).

title: This Is All Your Fault
lore: 'We seem to be made to suffer. It's our lot in life.'
gameText: Lose a droid to cancel all attrition against you at same site this turn. OR Re-target an opponent's weapon to one of your droids at same site as target. If droid is 'hit', use original target's forfeit number.

title: Utinni!
lore: Jawa trade language word for 'Come here!' Jawas work communally and scavenge for equipment.
gameText: If one of your Jawas is at the same location as any Utinni Effect, 'steal' that Utinni Effect into your hand, to use or lose as your own. OR Cancel any Interrupt or Effect with 'Jawa' in the card name.

title: Warrior's Courage
lore: Each Rebel soldier is driven by bravery and a belief in the Rebel Alliance's ideal of freedom. Courageous and quick-thinking Rebels often defeat Imperial legions.
gameText: If your warrior is defending a battle alone at a site, add one battle destiny. OR If Leia is defending a battle alone at a site, add two battle destiny.

title: Jawa
lore: Pesky scavenger species. One meter tall. Trade language nearly unintelligible...unless Jawas wish to be understood. Sometimes build massive stone fortresses.
gameText: *To deploy, requires 1 Force from each players' Force Pile. Cannot deploy otherwise. Deploy only on Tatooine, but may move elsewhere.

title: We're Doomed
lore: Threepio's many misadventures often threatened his continued operation. The luckless protocol droid developed a healthy sense of cynicism, and a keen grasp of the obvious.
gameText: If you have less than 15 Life Force, play during opponent's control phase. For remainder of turn, each time you must lose Force, the loss is cut in half (round up). If R2-D2 or C-3PO on table, round down.

title: Alderaan
locationDarkSideGameText: If you control, Force drain +1 here.
locationLightSideGameText: Subtract 1 from each of opponent's battle destiny draws here.

title: Dantooine
locationDarkSideGameText: If you control, Force drain +1 here.
locationLightSideGameText: Your capital starships deploy -2 and your starfighters deploy -1 here.

title: Death Star: Detention Block Control Room

titleComponents.name: Death Star: Detention Block Control Room

locationLightSideGameText: If you control, Force Drain +1 here and all imprisoned characters on Death Star are released.

title: Death Star: Docking Bay 327
locationDarkSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force.
locationLightSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force.

title: Death Star: Trash Compactor
locationLightSideGameText: You may deploy here without presence. If you control, Force drain +1 here.

title: Kessel
locationDarkSideGameText: If you control, Kessel Run is prevented (canceled).
locationLightSideGameText: If you control, Force drain +1 here.

title: Tatooine
locationDarkSideGameText: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Tatooine sites.
locationLightSideGameText: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Tatooine sites.

title: Tatooine: Cantina
locationDarkSideGameText: Your aliens here, except Tusken Raiders, are each forfeit +1.
locationLightSideGameText: Your aliens here are each power +1.

title: Tatooine: Docking Bay 94
locationDarkSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.
locationLightSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force.

title: Jek Porkins
lore: Piloted Red 6 at Battle of Yavin. Specializes in strafing runs. Served in Tierfon Yellow Aces squadron at Tierfon Rebel Outpost. Free trader from Bestine system.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 6, also adds 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

title: Tatooine: Dune Sea
locationDarkSideGameText: Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.

title: Tatooine: Jawa Camp
locationLightSideGameText: Your Jawas deploy here for 1 Force from you only, for free if Sandcrawler present.

title: Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm
locationDarkSideGameText: Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here.
locationLightSideGameText: Beru Lars and Luke deploy -1 here.

title: Tatooine: Mos Eisley
locationLightSideGameText: During your control phase, you may move free from here directly to Cantina (or vice versa).

title: Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut
locationDarkSideGameText: If you control, Force drain +1 here.
locationLightSideGameText: Obi-Wan is deploy -3 here.

title: Yavin 4
locationDarkSideGameText: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Yavin 4 sites.
locationLightSideGameText: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Yavin 4 sites.

title: Yavin 4: Docking Bay
locationDarkSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.
locationLightSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here is free.

title: Yavin 4: Jungle
locationDarkSideGameText: If you control, Force drain +1 here.
locationLightSideGameText: A Rebel alone here battles at power +2 and is immune to attrition.

title: Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room
locationDarkSideGameText: If you control, Force drain +1 here.
locationLightSideGameText: If this is your starting location, Light Side goes first in game.

title: Yavin 4: Massassi War Room
locationDarkSideGameText: If you initiate a battle here, add one battle destiny.
locationLightSideGameText: If you control, with a leader here, all Stormtroopers and TIEs on table are forfeit -1.

title: Kabe
lore: Young female Chadra-Fan. Thief. Guardian is Muftak. Abandoned on Tatooine by slavers. Loves intoxicating juri juice. Once robbed Jabba the Hutt's dwelling in Mos Eisley.
gameText: During your control phase, may target one opponent's weapon or device at same site. Draw destiny. If destiny < target's destiny number, Kabe 'steals' device to use, or weapon to hold and transfer (for free) to a warrior at same site.

title: Corellian Corvette
lore: Multi-purpose Rebel Blockade Runner. Modular interior designed for troop or cargo transport. 150 meters long. Used by Rebels, pirates, corporations and the Empire.
gameText: May add 3 pilots, 4 passengers and 1 vehicle. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.

title: Gold 1
lore: Lead fighter of Gold Squadron at Battle of Yavin. Flown by Jon 'Dutch' Vander. Designated Specter 1 at Renforra Base.
gameText: May add 2 pilots or passengers. Must have pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.

title: Gold 5
lore: Flown by the veteran Rebel fighter pilot Pops during the Battle of Yavin. He personally supervised all repairs and maintenance.
gameText: May add 2 pilots or passengers, and 1 astromech. Must have pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.

title: Millennium Falcon
lore: Modified YT-1300 freighter. Owned by Lando Calrissian until won by Han in a sabacc game. 26.7 meters long. 'She may not look like much, but she's got it where it counts.'
gameText: May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Immune to attrition < 5 if Han, Chewie or Lando piloting. Has ship-docking capability. Must have pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.

title: Red 1
lore: Lead fighter of Red Squadron at Battle of Yavin. Flown by Garven Dreis. Also served at main Rebel base on Dantooine.
gameText: May add 1 pilot. Must have pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.

title: Red 3
lore: Biggs Darklighter's fighter at Battle of Yavin. Part of Ecliptic Evaders squadron near Sullust until transferred to Yavin Base.
gameText: May add 1 pilot and 1 astromech. Must have pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.

title: X-wing
lore: Model T-65 by Incom Corporation. Delivered to Alliance by defecting design team. 12.5 meters long. Wings deploy in an 'X' position for better weapons coverage.
gameText: Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.

title: Y-wing
lore: Rugged Rebel Alliance fighter. BTL-S3 has room for a second pilot to assist weapons operations. 16 meters long. Built by Koensayr.
gameText: May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.

title: Lift Tube
lore: System of enclosed high-speed vertical and horizontal transport cylinders. Used in space stations, large starships, Death Stars, etc.
gameText: May carry 4 passengers. Deploy and move only at interior mobile sites. May move without presence aboard. Also, may move as a 'react' only to a battle or Force drain (if within range).

title: Luke's X-34 Landspeeder
lore: Skywalker's SoroSuub. Common open air transport. Top speed 250 km per hour. Repulsorlift drive keeps it suspended one meter above ground, even when parked.
gameText: May add 1 driver and 2 passengers. Moves free if Luke aboard. May move as a 'react.'

title: Kal'Falnl C'ndros
lore: A female Quor'sav, a warm-blooded, avian/monotreme species. 3.5 meters tall. Over-protective mother. Freelance pilot. Has custom-built ship with tall corridors. Lays eggs.
gameText: When in a battle, if both players draw only one battle destiny and yours is higher, reduces opponent's total battle destiny to zero. Landspeed = 3. Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. May not be aboard starfighters or enclosed vehicles.

title: Sandcrawler
lore: Warren-like enclosed homes for Jawa tribes. Protects against Tatooine predators. Originally mining vehicles. Jawas claimed them when mines abandoned. No two look alike.
gameText: Deploys only to a Tatooine site. May add 1 driver and 7 passengers. Cannot move to mobile sites. Adds 1 to forfeit of each Jawa at same exterior site.

title: SoroSuub V-35 Landspeeder
lore: Typical old model Courier landspeeder such as the one used by Lars family for trips to Anchorhead. Has cargo compartment. Enclosed seating.
gameText: May add 1 driver and 3 passengers. Moves free if Owen Lars, Beru Lars or Luke aboard. May move as a 'react'.

title: Blaster
lore: A Merr-Sonn Model 44 blaster pistol. Uses power packs and high-energy blaster gases to shoot bolts of explosive coherent light energy.
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on your warrior. May target a character, creature or vehicle using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny > defense value.

title: Blaster Rifle
lore: BlasTech E-11 blaster rifle. Standard issue for Imperial forces. So numerous that many have been stolen by Rebels. Extendable stock. Carries energy for 100 shots.
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy on your warrior. May target a character, creature or vehicle using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 > defense value.

title: Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol
lore: BlasTech DL-44 heavy pistol. Short range, but relatively powerful. Carries energy for 25 shots. Illegal or restricted on most systems.
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on Han, or 3 on your warrior. May target a character, creature or vehicle using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 > defense value. If hit by Han, target's forfeit = 0.

title: Jedi Lightsaber
lore: Elegant sword of pure energy. 'This is the weapon of a Jedi Knight. Not as clumsy or as random as a blaster. A lightsaber can be dangerous to an unskilled user.'
gameText: Use X Force to deploy on your warrior where X = (7 - warrior's ability). May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature by using X Force. Draw two destiny. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.

title: Leia's Sporting Blaster
lore: Defender sporting blaster, made by Drearian Defense Conglomerate. Intended for personal defense or small-game hunting. Short range. Low power. Carries energy for 50 shots.
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on Leia, or 2 on your warrior. May target a character, creature or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny -1 > defense value. If hit by Leia, target's forfeit = 0.

title: Obi-Wan's Lightsaber
lore: 'An elegant weapon for a more civilized time.' Miniaturized power cell. Uses rare crystals to focus the lightblade. This lightsaber was personally built by Obi-Wan.
gameText: Deploy on Obi-Wan. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.

title: Proton Torpedoes
lore: Powerful ballistic projectiles. Carries proton-scattering energy warheads. Short range. Pierces energy shields, but blocked by particle shields.
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on your X-wing, Y-wing or B-wing. May target a starship using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny > defense value.

title: Quad Laser Cannon
lore: Starship blaster, often slung in turret mounts to take advantage of light weight and quick targeting motions. Installed on many starships including the Millennium Falcon.
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy on your Corellian Corvette or Falcon. May target a starship using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Add 1 if targeting a starfighter. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.

title: Leesub Sirln
lore: Leesub is a Qiraash (near-human). Enslaved as child. Limited precognition. Selected by Imperial High Inquisitor Tremayne as Force adept. Escaped and hiding in Mos Eisley.
gameText: Once each turn during your control phase, may use 1 Force to guess a card type and point to a card in opponent's hand. Card must be shown. If guessed correctly, card is lost.

title: Tagge Seeker
lore: Military version of a 'remote.' Programmed to stalk specific targets or secondary targets. Heat and light sensors track with fatal accuracy. Can stow away on starships.
gameText: Deploys for 1 Force to an unoccupied site. Deploys and moves like an undercover spy. When present with Tagge (or warrior) of ability < 3, choose one to be immediately lost (treat as an 'all cards' situation). Seeker is also lost.

title: Tarkin Seeker
lore: Military version of a 'remote.' Programmed to stalk specific targets or secondary targets. Heat and light sensors track with fatal accuracy. Can stow away on starships.
gameText: Deploys for 1 Force to an unoccupied site. Deploys and moves like an undercover spy. When present with Tarkin (or alien) of ability < 3, choose one to be immediately lost (treat as an 'all cards' situation). Seeker is also lost.

title: Timer Mine
lore: A timer-activated explosive device designed to be placed by a mining droid. Typically used in ore and spice mines for demolition. Also has many military applications.
gameText: Deploy on opponent's side at same site as one of your mining droids. 'Explodes' at beginning of your next turn. Draw destiny. That number of opponent's characters there are immediately lost (owner's choice). Timer Mine is also lost.

title: Leia Organa
lore: Strong-willed princess from Alderaan. Youngest Imperial Senator ever. Used diplomatic immunity to spy for Rebels. Led relief effort on Ralltir. Natural leader.
gameText: Adds 1 to power of each Rebel present with her at a Death Star site. 'Diplomatic' immunity to attrition < 2.

title: LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay)
lore: Armored military droid which specializes in laying explosive mines. Originally intended to set charges inside ore and spice mines, but has also been converted for military use.
gameText: At any time during your turn, may use 1 Force to 'defuse' (lose) any one mine at same site.

title: Luke Skywalker
lore: Son of Anakin Skywalker. Student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Honed piloting skills while bullseyeing womp rats in Beggar's Canyon aboard T-16 skyhopper.
gameText: While Luke is not on Tatooine your total Force generation is +1. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 5, also adds 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition < 3.

title: Beru Lars
lore: Wife of Owen Lars and guardian of Luke Skywalker. Quietly lobbied Owen to allow Luke to attend Academy. Maintains Lars' farm hydroponics labs.
gameText: Forfeit +2 when at same site as Owen Lars or a Hydroponics Station. If lost from table during opponent's turn, Luke is power +3 until the end of your next turn.

title: Momaw Nadon
lore: Male Ithorian, from a tree-loving race derogatorily nicknamed, 'Hammerheads.' Master of animal husbandry and horticulture. Former herd ship leader. Rebel spy.
gameText: During your control phase, may snare (steal) one Bantha, Dewback, Wampa, Rancor, Bubo, or Dragonsnake present at same site.

title: Obi-Wan Kenobi
lore: Jedi Knight. Trained by Yoda. Friend of Bail Organa. General Kenobi became a hero of the Old Republic during the Clone Wars. Mentor of Anakin and Luke Skywalker.
gameText: When a battle was just initiated where present, may use 1 Force to choose one opponent's character of ability = 1 present to move away (for free), or that character is lost. Immune to attrition < 5.

title: Owen Lars
lore: Guardian of Luke Skywalker. Husband of Beru Lars. Brother of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Farmer of moisture. Disapprover of Luke's desire to leave Tatooine.
gameText: Deploys free at Lars' Moisture Farm. Power +2 if at same site as Beru Lars or a Vaporator. If lost from table during opponent's turn, Luke is power +3 until the end of your next turn.

title: Pops
lore: Piloted Gold 5 at Battle of Yavin. Real name Davish Krail. Veteran pilot. Flew fighters for two decades. Wingman of Gold Leader.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Gold 5, also adds 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

title: R2-X2 (Artoo-Extoo)
lore: Typical starfighter pilot assistant. Contains ten coordinates for hyperspace jumps. Built-in tools and computer interfaces. R2-X2 was assigned to Red 10 at Yavin Base.
gameText: While aboard any starfighter, adds 1 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed.

title: R4-E1 (Arfour-Eeone)
lore: One of numerous vehicle computer operation droids, manufactured by Industrial Automation. This unit, R4-E1, is a companion of BoShek. Rambunctious. Fiercely independent.
gameText: While aboard a non-creature vehicle, adds 1 to power, maneuver and landspeed. May drive transport vehicles.

title: Rebel Guard
lore: Galen Torg was selected for honor guard duty during ceremony following the Battle of Yavin. He is typical of the hard-working, unsung heroes in the Rebel Alliance.
gameText: Power +4 when defending a battle. Cannot move.

title: Rebel Pilot
lore: Lt. Wenton Chan, from Corulag, is typical of the new pilots who volunteer for dangerous duty in the Rebellion. Few have Academy training. Most learn piloting on skyhoppers.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots.

title: Rebel Trooper
lore: Corellian Corvette trooper Ensign Chad Hilse, an Alderaanian, typifies the loyal Rebel volunteers dedicated to defeating the Empire. Trained in starship and ground combat.
gameText: Deploys free to same site as one of your Rebels with ability > 2.

title: Red Leader
lore: X-wing pilot Garven Dreis. Led Red Squadron at the Battle of Yavin, and fired an unsuccessful shot at the Death Star thermal exhaust port. Served at Dantooine Rebel base.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 1, also adds 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Adds 1 to forfeit of each other Red Squadron pilot at same location.

title: Biggs Darklighter
lore: Piloted Red 3 at Battle of Yavin. Childhood friend of Luke. Led mutiny on Rand Ecliptic and theft of Ecliptic from shipyards on Bestine. Ecliptic Evaders emblem on helmet.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 3, also adds 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

title: Shistavanen Wolfman
lore: Lak Sivrak is a typical Shistavanen male. Ferocious, but not aggressive. Often trained as scouts at Imperial academies, but they despise the ambitions of the New Order.
gameText: May move to an adjacent site as a 'react'.

title: Talz
lore: Muftak is a typical male Talz from Alzoc III, a system enslaved by the Empire. A Talz's second pair of eyes provide excellent night vision. Muftak is a friend and protector of Kabe.
gameText: May forfeit in place of any other character hit by a weapon at same site, restoring that character to normal. Any Talz is power +2 under 'nighttime conditions'.

title: WED-9-M1 'Bantha' Droid
lore: Unique treadwell droid cobbled together by Jawas. Now owned by the DeMaals, proprietors of Docking Bay 94. Nicknamed 'bantha' for its slow and stubborn personality.
gameText: Adds immunity to attrition < 2 to all your vehicles and droids at same location. Also, if 'bantha' droid is at a docking bay, adds immunity to attrition < 3 to all your starfighters at the related system and related sectors and may cancel Lateral Damage.

title: Wioslea
lore: Bought Luke's landspeeder for Spaceport Speeders. A Vuvrian female. Gambler who owes Jabba 1,000 credits in wagering debts. Speaks many languages.
gameText: During your control phase, may use 1 Force to target an opponent's unoccupied transport vehicle or droid present. Draw destiny. If destiny > target's destiny number, use Force equal to target's deploy cost to 'purchase' target (use as if stolen).

title: Caller
lore: Hand-held device that can remotely command restraining bolt. Each caller can be keyed to specific bolt. Used by many species. Also called 'restraining bolt activators.
gameText: Deploy on a Rebel or Jawa. During your control phase, may steal one droid at same site if it is controlled by a Restraining Bolt. After droid is stolen, Restraining Bolt returns to owner's hand.

title: Electrobinoculars
lore: Enhances distant targets using a computer-assisted zoom technology. Provides range information. Works in low-light. Rugged case protects the internal systems.
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on any warrior. At any time, you may peek at the top card of your Reserve Deck by using 2 Force. You may choose to move that card to the top of your Force Pile.

title: Fusion Generator Supply Tanks
lore: Uses standard fusion technology. Provides starships with energy for hyperspace travel. Installed at docking bays and throughout the Outer Rim Territories.
gameText: Deploy on your starship at a system or sector where a related docking bay is on table. Adds 1 to hyperspeed, power and maneuver.

title: Hydroponics Station
lore: Grows fruits and vegetables. Very efficient water use. Often underground. Feeds moisture farm families, but excess vegetables are often sold at markets.
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on any exterior Tatooine site. Cannot be moved. The first Force you activate during your activate phase may be drawn into hand instead. If a Vaporator on table, the second Force you activate may also be drawn into hand.

title: Restraining Bolt
lore: Fits in a special socket on a droid's body. When installed, restricts actions of droids, forcing them to follow orders. Can be operated remotely by a 'caller.'
gameText: Deploy on any droid at any site. Droid cannot move and cannot utilize its 'game text.' During your deploy phase, Restraining Bolt may be transferred (for free) to another droid at same site.

title: Targeting Computer
lore: Specially designed for use on Rebel starfighters. Assists pilots on torpedo runs. Automatically locks on pre-programmed target points.
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy on any starship. Adds 1 to starship's maneuver. If this starship is using a weapon during a battle, you may fire that weapon twice, separately or combined. Subtract 1 from each destiny draw when firing.

title: BoShek
lore: Rogue pilot. Outlaw starship tech. Has secret lab in Mos Eisley. He bragged about beating Han Solo's Kessel Run record. Left fringe life behind after meeting Obi-Wan Kenobi.
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. May make a Kessel Run in place of a smuggler. Immune to attrition < 3.

title: Tatooine Utility Belt
lore: Survival gear, food and tools are stored in small compartments. Made from bantha hide. Used by Luke and other Tatooine inhabitants.
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on any Rebel or alien. While on Tatooine, that character's power and forfeit are +2.

title: Vaporator
lore: Essential for life on desert planets. Condenses water vapor from atmosphere. Has purification filters and coolant tanks. Protects against drought and harsh conditions.
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on any Tatooine site. Cannot be moved. Protects all characters at same site, or an adjacent site, from Gravel Storm.

title: A Tremor In The Force
lore: 'Stand by . . .'
gameText: Once per game, during your deploy phase, 'insert' (face down) into opponent's Reserve Deck; reshuffle. When effect reaches top it is immediately lost, but opponent may not activate any more Force that turn. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Affect Mind
lore: 'What was that?' The Jedi power known as 'affect mind' is often used to create minor distractions, allowing Jedi to elude enemies rather than engage them in battle.
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on one of your Jedi. While present at a site, unless a Dark Jedi is also present, opponent's total ability at same location is reduced by 2.

title: Beggar
lore: Many Mos Eisley citizens, once swindled and robbed, become destitute. Unable to afford off-planet passage, they live in the streets and do odd jobs or beg.
gameText: Use 3 Force to deploy on any exterior Tatooine site (free at Beggar's Canyon). You may use any amount of Force in the opponent's Force Pile during your turns. However, if you use more than 1 of the opponent's Force in a turn, Beggar is lost.

title: Crash Site Memorial
lore: Mos Eisley was built around wreckage of the colony ship Dowager Queen. The wreck remains as a monument where residents leave junk for Jawa scavengers.
gameText: Deploy on your side of table. If you just lost a vehicle, droid, weapon, or device, may stack it here. Once during your deploy phase, you may exchange any one card in hand with one card stacked here.

title: Death Star Plans
